mapper.insert: insert into dc_order_cancel (oc_type, oc_status, oc_reason, oc_quantity, oc_ramount, oc_turn, oc_point, oc_coupon, oc_re, oc_pr, od_detail_no) values ( #{ocType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ocStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ocReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ocQuantity, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{ocRamount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{ocTurn, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{ocPoint, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{ocCoupon, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{ocRe, jdbcType=DATE}, #{ocPr, jdbcType=DATE}, #{odDetailNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} )
mapper.select: select oc.oc_out_no, oc.oc_type, oc.oc_status, oc.oc_reason, oc.oc_quantity, oc.oc_ramount, oc.oc_turn, oc.oc_point, oc.oc_coupon, oc.oc_re, oc.oc_pr, oc.od_detail_no, od.od_product_name as OD_PRODUCT_TITLE, od.or_no as OR_NO from dc_order_cancel oc join dc_order_detail od on oc.od_detail_no = od.od_detail_no where oc.oc_out_no = #{ocOutNo}

select oc.oc_out_no, oc.oc_type, oc.oc_status, oc.oc_reason, oc.oc_quantity, oc.oc_ramount, oc.oc_turn, oc.oc_point, oc.oc_coupon, oc.oc_re, oc.oc_pr, oc.od_detail_no, od.od_product_name as OD_PRODUCT_TITLE, od.or_no as OR_NO from dc_order_cancel oc join dc_order_detail od on oc.od_detail_no = od.od_detail_no where oc.od_detail_no = #{odDetailNo} order by oc.oc_re desc
